I was very used to trains and usually didn't notice them after almost two decades of hearing the things rumble by on a semi-regular basis. One night I was up late as usual, and I hear a train approaching. This time it was different. Along with the typical sounds, I hear something else, blaring from the direction of the train...carnival music. It lasted a good minute or so as I was sitting there in full WTF mode. The only other person I lived with was my father, and he was dead asleep at the time, so he had no idea what I was talking about when I asked the next day. I never heard music coming from any train after that night, and I could never find an explanation.
